findings.title: Browser session redirect chain during manual MCP exploration — kiosk auto-idle interceptor pushes routes away from /admin/* under specific conditions
findings.evidence: During Phase B.1 manual MCP-driven navigation, /admin/cash-overview was repeatedly bounced to /admin/pos, /admin/kitchen-display-system, /kiosk/idle, /kiosk/categories, or /kiosk/cart within 2-5s of mount. Root cause analysis: foodkingConfig.staffOnlyMode=true + kioskAutoLogin=false combination is correct for daily admin operation, but the kiosk idle-timer interval registered by KioskAppComponent or kiosk-idle route guards (resources/js/components/frontend/kiosk/KioskAppComponent.vue:953-969) survives SPA route transitions in some conditions. The owner's normal workflow uses sidebar menu click flow (not direct URL navigation) which dodges this. NOT REPRO via playwright spec — spec uses controlled login + immediate navigation without idle-timer arming. Owner-impact: ZERO on production behavior.
